title: mentha caucasica
intro: Mentha caucasica, commonly known as Horse Mint, is a perennial herb native to the Caucasus region. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including acting as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic, which can aid in relieving digestive issues and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Mentha caucasica include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions. Additionally, Horse Mint has been traditionally used to treat various conditions, including headaches, fever, and sore throats, due to its soothing and calming effects.
